tool_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE fresh original FULL-BODY blink pose of the EXACT African wild dog mascot in the identity reference. Single isolated transparent sprite, NOT a sheet. Preserve the neutral reference absolutely: EXACT ear size/shape/spacing, exact head WIDTH and HEIGHT, exact head/ear crown levels relative to feet, same muzzle size, exact torso length/width, same two relaxed paws at sides and feet stance, same single raised white-tipped tail. The reference has very large circular brown ears with cream inner shapes, irregular asymmetric golden-yellow/brown/cream body patches; preserve their placement and proportions. Change ONLY the two open eyes into simple gentle fully closed brown eyelid curves. No nod, stretch, squat, shrinking, ear movement, head ballooning or other body action. Same warm thin brown outline and subtle paint texture inside bounded shapes, same adopted palette, chibi upright slight anthropomorphic world. Generous full native1254-scale canvas like reference, requested3072 if supported, full ear/tail/foot endpoints. No background, shadow, ground, labels, extra prop or character. Reference is identity/style input only, draw original new. 
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.
